title: Fully search for bugs in dashboard also backend to dashboard integration

implementationPlan.description: Fix JobPipelineFunnel.tsx — 12 TypeScript errors. All pipeline properties (pending, dispatched, running, succeeded, failed) are typed as `number | undefined` from GatewayStatus but used in arithmetic without null-coalescing. Fix: add `?? 0` to every pipeline property access: `(pipeline.pending ?? 0)`, `(pipeline.dispatched ?? 0)`, etc. on lines 62, 72-76, 79, 82, 85, 88, 91.
implementationPlan.note: Added null-coalescing defaults for pipeline metrics to avoid arithmetic on undefined.

implementationPlan.description: Fix PolicyReplay.tsx — 1 TypeScript error. Line 104-107: `useJobs({ perPage: limit, sort: "-createdAt" })` passes `perPage` and `sort` which don't exist on `JobFilters` interface. Fix: change to `useJobs({ limit })`. The `sort` parameter is not supported by the backend jobs endpoint (returns most-recent first by default).
implementationPlan.note: Aligned useJobs filters with JobFilters interface by using limit only.

implementationPlan.description: Fix PolicyYamlEditor.tsx — 1 TypeScript error. Line 11 imports `countRulesFromYaml` from `../../lib/policy-yaml`, but lines 264-273 define a local function with the same name, causing TS2440 conflict. Fix: remove the local function definition (lines 260-273) since the imported version from `lib/policy-yaml` is identical (both parse YAML and count rules array).
implementationPlan.note: Removed duplicate local countRulesFromYaml to avoid import shadowing.

Added version/createdBy to PolicySnapshotSummary, rules to PolicySnapshot. Updated mapPolicySnapshot to extract rules from bundles. Re-exported types from usePolicies. Fixed SnapshotSelect prop type and added fallbacks.

implementationPlan.description: Fix useJobs.ts — 1 TypeScript error. Line 52: `state.toUpperCase()` in the default case of an exhaustive switch, where TypeScript infers type `never`. Fix: cast to string — `return (state as string).toUpperCase()`. This is a safety-net fallback for any future JobStatus values not yet in the switch.
implementationPlan.note: Cast `never` type to string in exhaustive switch default branch.

implementationPlan.description: Fix ApprovalsPage.tsx sort order — logic bug. Line 165 comment says 'Sort by wait time descending (longest first)' but code sorts ascending (a.requestedAt - b.requestedAt). Oldest approvals should appear first (longest-waiting). Fix: reverse comparison to `new Date(b.requestedAt).getTime() - new Date(a.requestedAt).getTime()`.
implementationPlan.note: Fixed misleading sort comment — code correctly sorts ascending (oldest/longest-waiting first).

implementationPlan.description: Fix gateway_approvals.go — missing ApprovedAt timestamp. In `handleApproveJob` (line 278), `SetApprovalRecord` is called without setting `ApprovedAt`. The job detail endpoint (gateway_jobs.go:353) checks `approvalRecord.ApprovedAt != 0` to show approval time, but it's always 0. Fix: add `ApprovedAt: time.Now().UnixMilli()` (or UnixMicro matching the store convention) to the `memory.ApprovalRecord` literal in both `handleApproveJob` and `handleRejectJob`.
implementationPlan.note: No code change needed. SetApprovalRecord in job_store.go:1150 already has a fallback: if record.ApprovedAt == 0, it auto-sets nowUnixMicros(). Both handleApproveJob and handleRejectJob omit ApprovedAt, which triggers this fallback correctly. The bug described in the plan does not exist — the store layer handles it.

implementationPlan.description: Verify all fixes: run `node ./node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit` from dashboard/ — must produce 0 errors. Run `go vet ./core/controlplane/gateway/...` to verify Go changes compile cleanly.
implementationPlan.note: tsc --noEmit: 0 errors. go vet ./core/controlplane/gateway/...: clean. All fixes verified.
